draft.emotion: relaxed and warm, holding a favorite drink while taking a quiet break
notes: Typically refers to cups with handles (for coffee or tea) or paper/plastic cups. Contrast with コップ (koppu), which usually refers to a drinking glass or tumbler without a handle.
As a cooking measurement in Japan, 1 cup (１カップ) is 200 ml.
